Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Last Tuesday, Ben and Mia went to the food festival. Ben and Mia had great fun there. In fact, the explorers had to endure cold nights in the tent.
Ben spent the weekend at the library. Ben borrowed a book about art from the library. Mia's birthday is in January. Also, my brother is a real computer geek.
Ben hopes to visit Rome one day. Mia is interested in dancing. It takes twenty minutes to get to the food festival by bike. In my estimation, the repairs will cost about two hundred dollars.
Ben thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. The food festival is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the kitchen table.
